evidence: Calls player_attribute_record_value_adjust_for_category for selectors 0x11, 0x0f, 0x10, and 0x3f, converts each returned integer to float, divides each by 100, sums them, and multiplies by 0.25 to return their average: decompiled/main/main_0171.c:10101-10136. Indexed callers pass an attribute-record pointer and category value: decompiled/main/main_0171.c:32658-32661 and 35031-35035.

For a non-null record pointer, calls compare_ranked_record_metrics_if_selector_mask_matches with selector IDs 0 through 11, masks each result to a boolean, and sums the twelve booleans into the return value: decompiled/main/main_0034.c:40129-40211. Indexed caller consumes the returned low byte: decompiled/main/main_0034.c:39718-39722.

The indexed caller is process_equipment_attribute_octetstrings and supplies the entry value as argument x1: decompiled/main/main_0160.c:19908-19912 and 19934-19938. The body resolves a node for a fixed global key, looks up its linked-list destination, and when the destination is nonzero calls append_node_to_linked_list with the node and incoming value (x2), then repeats for a second fixed key: decompiled/main/main_0160.c:18184-18208. The caller establishes the octet-string context; the list helper establishes the append operation.

Body writes byte value 1 at argument+0x98, conditionally queries context-status selector 9 and invokes additional opaque helpers when the returned status equals 4. The game-facing role is unresolved and there is no indexed caller: decompiled/main/main_0080.c:11688-11713.

Body queries context-status selector 0x13 and selects local mode value 1 or 7, then initializes opaque temporary state and loops over helper-managed records, writing zero bytes at offsets 7 and 15. Its broader operation is unresolved; indexed caller ignores the return value: decompiled/main/main_0056.c:28588-28631; caller decompiled/main/main_0056.c:14434-14438.
